visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white historical-style engraving depicting a group of people in a dimly lit, outdoor, possibly wooded setting at night. A figure in the foreground, dressed in buckskins and a fur cap, sits on a rock and holds a flaming torch high, illuminating the scene. Facing this figure is a Native American man standing tall with feathers in his hair. Behind the torch-bearer stand three other individuals: a man in an 18th-century military-style coat and two women in period-appropriate dresses and bonnets.
